highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.148.0 is the first stable v4 release, built on Skia m148.
highlights_body: It adds variable and color fonts, animated WebP encoding, and reworks the singleton lifecycle. This is a breaking release with several behavioral changes from the m132/m147/m148 Skia upgrade — check the changes below before upgrading.

breaking.title: New SKFont() now has an empty typeface instead of a lazy default
breaking.body: new SKFont().Typeface used to resolve to the platform default at draw time; it now stores SKTypeface.Empty, so MeasureText returns 0 and nothing draws. Construct with an explicit typeface (e.g. new SKFont(SKTypeface.Default)) and detect "unset" with Typeface.IsEmpty instead of a null check.

breaking.title: new SKPaint().Typeface now returns Default instead of null
breaking.body: SkiaSharp still seeds a usable default font, but code that checked paint.Typeface == null to detect "no typeface set" no longer fires. Use Typeface.IsEmpty, or drop the check.

breaking.title: SKTypeface.FromFamilyName("missing") no longer returns null on Android
breaking.body: All platforms are now consistent and return SKTypeface.Default for an unknown family. For a strict "was it actually found?" check, use SKFontManager.Default.MatchFamily(name, style), which still returns null on no match.

breaking.title: SKTypeface.Default is now guaranteed non-null
breaking.body: Default resolution moved to the font manager; behavior is unchanged on macOS/Windows/Linux, and Android API 36+ now falls back to SKTypeface.Empty instead of crashing.

breaking.title: SKStream.Move(long) now throws and is obsolete
breaking.body: The overload used to silently truncate out-of-range offsets to a native 32-bit int. It now throws OverflowException for out-of-range values and is marked [Obsolete] (CS0618). Call Move(int) with an in-range, validated offset instead.

breaking.title: GRContext.CreateVulkan aborts the process on Vulkan 1.0 instead of returning null
breaking.body: Ganesh now requires Vulkan 1.1 and calls a fatal native abort — not a catchable exception — when the instance/device version is below 1.1. Declare VK_API_VERSION_1_1 on both the VkApplicationInfo used to create the instance and on GRVkBackendContext.MaxAPIVersion (do not leave MaxAPIVersion at its unsafe default of 0). Vulkan-1.0-only hardware can no longer run Ganesh Vulkan and must fall back to another backend.

breaking.title: GRVkBackendContextNative dropped five interop fields
breaking.body: fMinAPIVersion, fInstanceVersion, fExtensions, fFeatures, and fOwnsInstanceAndDevice were removed. Delete those assignments; use fVkExtensions instead of fExtensions and fDeviceFeatures/fDeviceFeatures2 instead of fFeatures. Skia no longer manages instance/device ownership through the backend context.

breaking.title: GrVkYcbcrConversionInfo layout and identity changed
breaking.body: The struct gained a new Components field (backed by GRVkYcbcrComponents), and GRVkImageInfo.YcbcrConversionInfo retyped from GrVkYcbcrConversionInfo to GRVkYcbcrConversionInfo, losing value-equality (Equals/== / != are gone). Code that manually builds the struct or compares instances for equality must be updated.

breaking.title: SKNativeObject.IgnorePublicDispose lost its public setter
breaking.body: The property is now get-only from outside the type. Remove any external assignment to it.

bullets.lead: Skia bumped through m132, m133, m147, to m148
bullets.detail: Brings the bundled Skia engine up to the m148 upstream release line, the basis for this v4 line, plus the ongoing chrome/m147 upstream bug-fix merges.
Adds variable font support across SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp, plus color font palette selection, with improved variable font robustness.

bullets.lead: Animated WebP encoding and zero-copy stream data
bullets.detail: SKWebpEncoder can now encode animated WebP images, and SKStream.GetData() converts a stream to SKData without an extra copy.
SKSurface.Draw and SKCanvas.DrawSurface now accept SKSamplingOptions to control filtering when compositing surfaces.
Adds an HBColor struct for hb_color_t, plus missing API wrappers and naming-convention fixes across the binding.

bullets.lead: Legacy pre-v4 obsoletes promoted to compile errors
bullets.detail: Remaining pre-v4 obsolete APIs (legacy paint text/font state, and other trimmed obsolete enum members) now fail to compile instead of just warning, completing the v3-to-v4 migration path.
SKPixmap/SKBitmap.GetPixelSpan now uses RowBytes for stride and the correct axis (Width, not Height) for the (x, y) overload's offset, fixing incorrect pixel reads.
Fixes a crash when the SKPathBuilder backing an SKPath is collected before the path itself.

bullets.lead: Default-typeface resolution moved to managed code
bullets.detail: Fixes a null-typeface crash on newer Android by resolving the default typeface in the managed layer instead of relying on the native platform path.

bullets.lead: Android SKGLView rendering after tab switch
bullets.detail: Fixes SKGLView failing to render again after switching tabs in a MAUI TabBar.
Corrects Apple platform TFMs (26.0 for libraries, unversioned for apps) and fixes a missing WinUI projection DLL for .NET 9 consumers.

Reworks how SkiaSharp's native singleton instances are created and torn down, and moves the native-compatibility gate from a module initializer into the SkiaApi static constructor for more predictable startup.
Adds Linux Bionic native asset support and Tizen x64/arm64 native builds.
Drops native builds for pre-.NET 8 Emscripten versions.
Updates expat, HarfBuzz, libjpeg-turbo, FreeType, zlib, libpng, and libexpat to their latest versions.

contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Singleton lifecycle rework, variable font support, the SKPath finalizer fix, the m147 Skia bump, and Uno sample updates.
contributor_summaries.4Darmygeometry: Linux Bionic native asset support and PolySharp-based C# 13 support on legacy TFMs.
contributor_summaries.SimonvBez: Fixed SKGLView not rendering after a MAUI TabBar tab switch.

preview_summaries.v4.147.0-preview.1.1: Preview 1 opened the v4 line, bumping Skia to milestone 132/147 and adding native asset support for Linux Bionic and Tizen.
preview_summaries.v4.147.0-preview.2.1: Preview 2 continued the m147 bug-fix merges and CI stabilization work.
preview_summaries.v4.147.0-preview.3.1: Preview 3 added variable font support, color font palettes, animated WebP encoding, and SKStream.GetData(), plus the singleton lifecycle rework.
preview_summaries.v4.148.0-rc.1.2: Release Candidate 1 bumped to Skia m148, fixed the pixel-access and finalizer bugs, and promoted the remaining legacy obsoletes toward v4's stable API surface.

harfbuzz_summary: Adds an HBColor struct for hb_color_t along with variable font shaping support, and bumps the bundled HarfBuzz to 14.2.0.

v4.147.0-preview.1.1.headline: SkiaSharp 4.147.0 Preview 1 opens the v4 line on Skia m132/m147.
v4.147.0-preview.1.1.body: It adds Linux Bionic and Tizen native asset support alongside the initial v4 engine bump.

v4.147.0-preview.2.1.headline: SkiaSharp 4.147.0 Preview 2 continues stabilizing the v4 engine bump.

v4.147.0-preview.3.1.headline: SkiaSharp 4.147.0 Preview 3 adds variable fonts, color font palettes, and animated WebP encoding.
v4.147.0-preview.3.1.body: It also reworks the singleton lifecycle ahead of the v4 stable release.

v4.148.0-rc.1.2.headline: SkiaSharp 4.148.0 Release Candidate 1 bumps to Skia m148 and fixes pixel-access bugs.
v4.148.0-rc.1.2.body: It promotes the remaining legacy v3 obsoletes toward v4's final stable API surface.

v4.148.0.headline: SkiaSharp 4.148.0 is the first stable v4 release, built on Skia m148.
v4.148.0.body: It ships variable and color fonts, animated WebP encoding, a reworked singleton lifecycle, and several breaking changes from the v3-to-v4 engine upgrade.
